# Jurnal Ratu Dirgantara Cendikiawan (JRDC)

JRDC is an open-access, peer-reviewed academic journal publishing original research, systematic reviews, and case studies in economics, business, management, finance, and related social sciences.

## Key facts
- Full name: Jurnal Ratu Dirgantara Cendikiawan
- Abbreviation: JRDC
- ISSN (print): 2807-1234
- ISSN (online): 2807-5678
- Publisher: Yayasan Ratu Dirgantara Cendikiawan
- Peer review: Double-blind peer review
- Article processing charge (APC): None
- License: Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY)
- Languages: English and Indonesian
- Focus: Economics, Business, Management, Finance, Islamic Economics
